notes.title: Version 5.2.7, Rues & Ruses
notes.content: [h3][b]Dev Notes[/b][/h3][list][*][p]This update features an art overhaul, a new consort, plenty of voice acting, and lots more besides![/p][/*][*][p]But I have been primarily focused on advancing the main plotline. This has gone very well! I hope to share the first part of Chapter Two’s conclusion with you all next month.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Act V Features[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Art: A main sprite and side portraits for the kobold page (4 images, Irrelevant Art).[/p][/*][*][p]Art: A main sprite and side portrait for the selkie (2 images, Undoodle & Irrelevant Art).[/p][/*][*][p]Art: Emotes for battered Balthorne (6 images, Sintax Error & Irrelevant Art).[/p][/*][*][p]Art: Background art for the palace bailey (two variants, Exo Spectra).[/p][/*][*][p]Art: Background art for the palace kitchens (Exo Spectra).[/p][/*][*][p]Art: Background art for the palace stables (Exo Spectra).[/p][/*][*][p]Art: An eclipse variant for the forest’s background art.[/p][/*][*][p]Art: Regraded splash art for the omen, aberration, and union (3 images).[/p][/*][*][p]Voice: Malagar’s Act V conversation about his new lodgings (Jim Peakway).[/p][/*][*][p]Voice: Malagar’s thoughts on local phenomena (Vic Collins, edited by Cython).[/p][/*][*][p]Voice: Malagar’s thoughts on the Words (Vic Collins, edited by Cython).[/p][/*][*][p]Voice: Malagar’s thoughts on Valzira (Vic Collins, edited by Cython).[/p][/*][*][p]Voice: Malagar’s response to your advances (Vic Collins, edited by Cython).[/p][/*][*][p]Voice: Malagar’s part in the betrothal court event (Vic Collins, edited by Cython).[/p][/*][*][p]Voice: The first half of Marie-Anne’s midsummer night fever dream (Marina Montague, edited by Cython).[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Act I-IV Features[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Consort: Issa can be selected as your consort in Act IV (collab with DoItToJulia).[/p][/*][*][p]Dynamic: Issa receives an unexpected promotion to consort (collab with DoItToJulia).[/p][/*][*][p]Dynamic: Issa prepares a small feast (collab with DoItToJulia).[/p][/*][*][p]Dynamic: Issa redecorates your roost (collab with DoItToJulia).[/p][/*][*][p]Dynamic: Issa deals with the consequences of redecoration (collab with DoItToJulia).[/p][/*][*][p]Dynamic: Issa tells a story (collab with DoItToJulia).[/p][/*][*][p]Dynamic: Issa performs his ablutions (collab with DoItToJulia).[/p][/*][*][p]Dynamic: Issa provides a soothing massage (collab with DoItToJulia).[/p][/*][*][p]Dynamic: Issa does a magic trick (collab with DoItToJulia).[/p][/*][*][p]Dynamic: Issa soothes you after you suffer a defeat on the field (collab with DoItToJulia).[/p][/*][*][p]Dynamic: Issa spends time in front of a mirror (collab with DoItToJulia).[/p][/*][*][p]Dynamic: Expanded talk options for consort Issa (collab with DoItToJulia).[/p][/*][*][p]Dynamic: A last night visit to your consort Issa (collab with DoItToJulia).[/p][/*][*][p]Art: Remastered main sprites for Chia (two variants, Irrelevant Art).[/p][/*][*][p]Art: Background art for the dragon’s roost (two variants, Exo Spectra).[/p][/*][*][p]Art: Regraded splash art for the confrontation, strike, and showdown (3 images).[/p][/*][*][p]Art: Regraded splash art for the dragon’s infernal and protean imbuements (2 images).[/p][/*][*][p]Art: Regraded art for the war map (3 images).[/p][/*][*][p]Art: Regraded background art for the lairs (3 images).[/p][/*][*][p]Voice: The second half of Darja’s visit to Maelys (Nyah, edited by Mokkel).[/p][/*][*][p]Voice: The dragon’s part in his Moonday celebration (GreyScale).[/p][/*][*][p]Voice: Sabetha’s missing lines from her existing voiced scenes (Emery Aylar, edited by Mokkel).[/p][/*][*][p]Voice: The kobolds’ part in Cooch’s kobold fight club (Kobold34, edited by Mokkel).[/p][/*][*][p]Voice: The kobolds’ part in the assault on Pale Rock (Kobold34, edited by Mokkel).[/p][/*][*][p]Animation: Regrades for Adeline’s emergence splash animation (Amon Ra).[/p][/*][*][p]Sound: A variety of new sound effects have been added to the game, currently populating Acts I and II (HereToHelp).[/p][/*][*][p]UI: The textbox and frame have been adjusted for better appearance, readability, and use of available space.[/p][/*][*][p]UI: Emote portraits have been reframed and rescaled for better consistency (nine characters, 240 images).[/p][/*][*][p]UI: Custom names that start with lowercase letters will be capitalised if they appear at the start of a sentence (HereToHelp).[/p][/*][*][p]UI: An "Auto" button has been added. Autoplay behaviour can be customized in the Sound and Text settings. (HereToHelp)[/p][/*][*][p]UI: "Inline Character Icons" have been added as an (experimental) option to the Accessibility menu. If enabled, this will add a small image any time a character is mentioned by name. (HereToHelp).[/p][/*][*][p]UI: The last line of text will now persist into choice menus that would otherwise leave the textbox empty. This behaviour can be toggled in the Text settings (HereToHelp).[/p][/*][*][p]UI: The language selection UI has been reworked, and is now accessible from the icon in the bottom right of the main menu (HereToHelp).[/p][/*][*][p]Walkthrough: The walkthrough has been completely refreshed, improved, and extended up to the current version (Miah). [/p][/*][/list][p][b]Tweaks[/b][/p][list][*][p]Going forward, the starting Morale of empowered lair factions has been increased by one.[/p][/*][*][p]All machine translations have been withdrawn, in line with our recent announcement on the use of AI.[/p][/*][*][p]Gallery thumbnails have been updated for scenes that have had their art remastered or regraded.[/p][/*][*][p]The Herald will consistently address the dragon as "Your Divinity" if dragon-worship is the faith of the Realm.[/p][/*][*][p]The narrative terminology used for Issa has been adjusted.[/p][/*][*][p]The Walkthrough button now directs the player to an online-hosted version (HereToHelp).[/p][/*][*][p]The "Display" tab of the Preferences menu has been split into "Text" and "Display", with an improved layout (HereToHelp). [/p][/*][*][p]The interaction between automatic text pausing and setting "Text Speed" to maximum has been improved, and is much more clearly depicted in the GUI (HereToHelp). [/p][/*][*][p]The quick menu during the parody dream has had its options adjusted to accommodate the "Auto" button, and provide more sensible options for different screen sizes in general (HereToHelp). [/p][/*][*][p]The standard quick menu has been tweaked to appear better on small devices (HereToHelp). [/p][/*][*][p]Playing the parody dream with Enlarged Quick Menu enabled in the accessibility settings will now use the GUI for small devices (HereToHelp). [/p][/*][*][p]The Accessibility menu option to change the game's font to Atkinson Hyperlegible has been updated to use Atkinson Hyperlegible Next (HereToHelp).[/p][/*][*][p]The UI text colours have been subtly tweaked for higher contrast, improving legibility (HereToHelp).[/p][/*][*][p]A few options in the Preferences menu have been restyled to be more consistent with the rest of the UI (HereToHelp).[/p][/*][*][p]Adeline will cuddle you a little longer after your emergence, if you do not give her reason otherwise.[/p][/*][*][p]Leaving the entry blank when Darja asks what she should call the dragon will default to your chosen name, rather than "Ravager".[/p][/*][*][p]Issa’s dress discovery will happen on his third night as consort, if it does not happen sooner, with suitable framing.[/p][/*][*][p]If you are killed by Maelys at the end of Act III, you will be reminded of what it is you're supposed to be doing.[/p][/*][*][p]Marie-Anne's cursing has been made more cosmologically accurate.[/p][/*][*][p]The ‘eclipse’ background now includes stars.[/p][/*][*][p]Emote portraits now sit behind the outer frame.[/p][/*][*][p]The Language and Accessibility icons have had their colours adjusted to match the new UI color scheme.[/p][/*][*][p]The game's About page now uses the updated, higher-contrast UI colors.[/p][/*][*][p]More edge cases are covered by the Inline Character Icons accessibility setting.[/p][/*][*][p]Simplified Chinese characters are supported while the Traditional Chinese translation is selected.[/p][/*][*][p]Ravager’s internal media structure has been rationalised. This should have no impact on your play experience, but it helps us a lot.[/p][/*][*][p]Fewer lines require the player to click a second time to complete them.[/p][/*][*][p]Numerous minor logical inconsistencies have been corrected.[/p][/*][*][p]Spelling and punctuation has been better standardised throughout the game. [/p][/*][/list][p][b]Fixes[/b][/p][list][*][p]Cooch's pain emotes now show. These never displayed before, whoops![/p][/*][*][p]When drinking with Cooch and Darja, the dragon's drunken flashbacks will not include Chia if she has nothing to say.[/p][/*][*][p]Darja will properly respond to the player naming themselves after Celia.[/p][/*][*][p]Coldreach’s conquest difficulty for the proteans is now the same as for all other factions.[/p][/*][*][p]Changing Issa's name in Act V Chapter 2 will no longer cause a crash.[/p][/*][*][p]The button for automatic text pausing will no longer display as half-enabled when text pausing is manually set to exactly 0.5 seconds.[/p][/*][*][p]Save file labels now always show the proper colour when hovered.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a subtle visual artifact that appeared at the start of the parody dream.[/p][/*][*][p]Custom names should no longer be used inappropriately in dialogue from other people.[/p][/*][*][p]Our usual fixes for typos, formatting, and other minor issues.[/p][/*][*][p]...and everything found in the playtests. Thank you, playtesters![/p][/*][/list]
